movement: A.4 now has the exact geometric and arithmetic groups in every degree at every geometric generic nonordinary principally polarized abelian-surface stratum component. A complete normal-frame-component specialization argument, with the actual reduced constant-rank Lang bundle and original p-rank stratum hypotheses checked, reduces the remaining nonordinary ppav gate to nongeneric fixed moduli. The finite-prescribed-degree open and finite-field existence conclusions do not claim a point in a countable intersection.

A.4 closes the fixed mixed elliptic-product degree-one gate uniformly over every ordinary modulus, including all algebraic moduli. The exact Lang incidence dimension argument and full moving-kernel root inertia give geometric=arithmetic GL8(F2). The still-unpromoted degree-two wreath/grid draft is not counted in this review.

A.3 now has a proved positive-ordinary-index toral image lattice and an exact two-dimensional kernel-to-cokernel first-variation test at an etale double pullback. The restricted first and stable ranks are b-4, and determinant nonvanishing on the trace quotient is a sufficient explicit remaining step. The false stronger shortcut that variation factors through the source Cartier cokernel is retained as refuted by an exact probe; no uniform nonvanishing is asserted.

B.4 now has 1<=nu_min(p,p-1,2)<=2 for every p>=5. The mixed formal/height-one-filtered comparison is excluded, and the remaining p² test is reduced to two whole potentially supersingular groups with equal finite determinants. The closed logarithm-boundary proof further excludes square finite determinants. After primitive-norm normalization, m=(p-1)q with q dividing p+1, v2(q)=v2(p+1), and q>=4. At p5 only joint24 with the two explicit character patterns remains. All promoted B49-B51 proofs and exact certificates have root and companion audits; no remaining congruent pair or exact choice in{1,2} is asserted.
